title: Team charter artifact schema
description: The charter of an Agile team: its mission, members, working agreements, Definition of Done and Kanban.

owner.description: Agent slug of the owning author. Only the owner writes this artifact.

challengeLedger.description: The owner's answers to the expert challenge (see the definition).

topology.description: Team type. One of: stream-aligned | complicated-subsystem | platform | enabling.

method.description: How the team plans its work. One of: safe-scrum | safe-team-kanban.

members.description: Roles on the team (agent slugs and human roles); ten or fewer.

wipLimits.description: Work-in-process limit per Team Kanban state.

stepOutcomes.description: Step outcome record: one entry per step that committed this artifact.

challengeLedger.description: The owner's answer to the expert challenge. One entry per challenge packet of the latest run, written by the owner in the `revise` step: every finding is accepted, rejected or deferred with a reason. The human gate reads this ledger next to the artifact.

packet.description: Workspace-relative path of the challenge packet answered.

challenger.description: Agent slug of the expert who wrote the packet.

verdict.description: The packet's verdict, copied: pass | concerns | blocking | not-applicable.

responses.description: One response per finding of the packet (empty when the packet has no finding).

finding.description: Finding id in the packet, e.g. F1.

disposition.description: accepted (the artifact changed) | rejected (the owner disagrees, with the reason) | deferred (valid, handled later: say where).

note.description: One line: what changed, or why not.

stepOutcomes.description: Step outcome record. Every workflow step that commits this artifact appends exactly one entry, so the artifact itself carries the step's decision and the agent's reply stays indicative.

step.description: `<workflow-slug>/<step-slug>` of the step that appended this entry.

outcome.description: written (created) | revised (content changed) | confirmed (reviewed, still valid) | no-change (out of scope on this run) | none (not needed; the artifact records that decision).

note.description: One line: what the step decided and why.

friction.description: Optional. Workflow friction the actor observed (raw input for Inspect and Adapt, never a fix).
